name: Hiiragi Yoshiya
source:
A serious character with a strong sense of justice, Yoshiya is intolerant of irrationality and stupidity.

[spoiler]he is the second Rosei (盧生).

in Bansenjin, Yoshiya (military uniform) is a rosei who have been resolved Amakasu Incident and yoshiya (school uniform) is the fictional character that created by [url=https://vndb.org/c31934]Shizuno[/url]
[/spoiler]
